description: List all bolt patterns (PCD) available in the database, optionally filtered by rim dimensions and centre bore range. Bolt pattern format: stud-count × circle-diameter in mm (e.g. "5x112"). Use this to discover valid bolt_pattern values before calling search-by-rim.

cb_max.description: Maximum centre bore in mm. Must be positive. Use instead of cb for a range query.

cb_min.description: Minimum centre bore in mm. Must be positive. Use instead of cb for a range query.

pcd.description: Pitch circle diameter in mm (e.g. 112). Must be positive. Part of bolt pattern. Use bolt_pattern when possible.

region.description: Market region code (e.g. "eudm", "usdm"). Get codes from list-regions.

rim_diameter.description: Rim diameter in inches (e.g. 18). Must be positive. Filters results to this diameter only.

rim_offset_max.description: Maximum rim offset (ET) in mm, range -100 to 100. Use instead of rim_offset for a range query.

rim_offset_min.description: Minimum rim offset (ET) in mm, range -100 to 100. Use instead of rim_offset for a range query.

rim_width.description: Rim width in inches from bead seat to bead seat (e.g. 8.0). Must be positive.

stud_holes.description: Number of stud holes (lug count, e.g. 4 or 5). Minimum 3.

name: list-rim-bolt-patterns
